dedupe_keys.name: out of plane and in plane experiments for structural masonry walls reinforced with grade 80 bars

description: Out-of-plane and in-plane experiments for structural masonry walls reinforced with Grade 80 bars is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Dimitrios Kalliontzis, University of Houston (uh.edu). The use of non-prestressed high-strength steel reinforcing bars (HSRBs) has increased in structural engineering due to their potential to reduce reinforcement quantities while maintaining or enhancing structural capacity. Although Grade 80 reinforcement has gained broader acceptance in reinforced concrete construction, its use in structural masonry remains restricted by current design provisions. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: High-strength steel reinforcement,  concrete masonry,  clay brick masonry,  Grade 80 bars. Published 2025-06-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
